description: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies 🤤🍪 These delicious cookies are perfect when you want a quick cookie fix as they don’t require chilling. I absolutely love the texture of these - soft, chewy and crunchy all at once with as many chocolate chips as your heart desires! Full recipe, details & method on www.janespatisserie.com INGREDIENTS 175 g unsalted butter 225 g light brown soft sugar 100 g white granulated sugar  1 tsp vanilla extract 1 medium egg 1 egg yolk 275 g plain flour 1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda 1/2 tsp sea salt 325 g chocolate chips #JanesPatisserie #EasyBakes #CookieRecipes #ChocolateChipCookie #CookieRecipe
transcript: Chewy chocolate chip cookies are one of the best things you can possibly make and this easy no-chill recipe is utterly delicious, incredibly more-ish and you'll want to make it in again and again to get that soft chewy chocolatey cookie goodness. I always start by beating together my butter and two sugars and on this video I'm purposely doing it by hand show you just how easy it is. Once you've creamed them together add your vanilla egg and egg yolk with your wet ingredients, mix until fully combined and then of course you can add your dry ingredients. Plain flour, bicarb and sea salt create the perfect dry mix for this cookie dough and then you add chocolate chips to your heart's content. I always add quite a lot of chocolate chips because I love it but you can easily add less if you wish it's entirely up to you and you can also use chocolate chips, chocolate chunks, chopped up chocolate bar, anything you want. I then use a five centimetre scoop to portion all of my cookies, then I split them across trays, I do six per tray to allow room for spreading, then I bake in my preheated oven. Once they're out they're warm, gooey and perfect and I personally like to add on a little extra sea salt but this is entirely optional. Find the full recipe on my blog as always and enjoy.
